description:
Confirmed: sync-results-data-to-published.yml 'Build mirror branch' overlays a hardcoded FILE_PATHS list (about lines 163-174; trigger paths lines 12-18; git add set about line 202) onto a branch cut from published-results. results-data/validate_corpus.py now loads benchbox/core/results/subscale_policy.py by path; that file is not in the list, so the mirror fails: 'validate_corpus.CorpusReadError: ERROR cannot load .../benchbox/core/results/subscale_policy.py' (run 39095414032, 2026-10-18; the three newest runs failed). published-results therefore falls further behind develop and t3:drift stays red (inference: the causal link to the 2026-10-12 drift failure is not proven; the mirror failure itself is).
Work: add subscale_policy.py to all three places; add a test that the list covers every module validate_corpus.py and validate_submission.py load or import (derive by AST), so the next added dependency fails a unit test rather than the nightly.
Constraint: the list is a trust boundary onto a PUBLIC branch: add only modules the test proves missing, no wildcard, no directory copy.
GATE-C: if the test finds further missing modules, add each only if it is public-safe code (no private paths, tokens or internal-only data); otherwise stop and block with the evidence.
